name: Create ROWBLY.md concept for agents using Rowbly
description:
- Every rowbly board is setup a little differently
- Teams and individuals often times have their own rituals around using a kanban board.
- These rituals aren't really written down anywhere and seldom inforced in the application.

- Because of the above, we want to encode those rituals into a ROWBLY.md file.
- This file will live in the data root's `.rowbly/` folder.
- Update rowbly reference to have the agent look for this and use it within the reference
